string-array.name: guide_steps
string-array.item: Sign in on the console with the same PlayStation Network account you used here.
Open Settings › System › Remote Play and turn on \"Enable Remote Play\".
To start it from rest mode: Settings › System › Power Saving › Features Available in Rest Mode, and turn on \"Stay Connected to the Internet\" and \"Enable Turning On PS5 from Network\".
On this network: when the console shows up here, tap Link. On the console open Settings › System › Remote Play › Link Device and type the 8-digit code it shows.
Away from home there is no code: the console appears under \"Over the internet\" by itself.

resources.string: Use this at home, with the headset on the same Wi-Fi as the console.
The console did not complete the connection. Restart the console (turn it fully off and on again) and try once more.
The console says Remote Play is already in use by another device. Close the other connection and try again. If there is none, restart the console.
The console refused the connection. Check that Remote Play is on at the console and that it is still linked to this headset.
The console asks for a newer version of this app. Update Farsofa.
The console ended the connection. This happens when someone starts using the console with the same account.
Could not link over the internet. Check that the console is on the same PlayStation account you used here.
The connection dropped. If it keeps happening, restart the console and try again.
Could not connect over the internet (%1$s). See \"How to prepare the console\"; if everything is already on, restart the console and try again.
Something went wrong? Send an error report
The app keeps a technical diary on the headset of the last times you played: what worked, where the connection stopped, how good the Wi-Fi was. Sending it helps find and fix the problem.
Not included: your account, your password, the name of the console, addresses on your network. Nothing is sent unless you tap Send.
